name: M6.KernelFibers.embed_mk
statement: ∀ (F K : M6.KernelFibers.BP) (hF : F.Monic) (h : M6.KernelFibers.BP), M6.KernelFibers.embed F K hF (AdjoinRoot.mk F h) = AdjoinRoot.mk (F*K) (K*h)
guidance: Use modByMonicHom_mk and AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_mk. F divides h-h%ₘF; F*K divides K times this difference. Explicit polynomial quotient/remainder identities. Return tactic lines without leading by.
